sections.title: jegy vs. bérlet
sections.content: jegy ("ticket") is what you buy for a single ride; bérlet ("pass") covers a longer period — a napi bérlet ("day pass") or a heti bérlet ("weekly pass", reusing heti from making a schedule). To buy one, use vált ("to change, exchange"): jegyet vált is the standard way to say "buy a ticket," even though vált usually means "to change" or "to exchange." You'll see it on signs: Kérjük, váltson jegyet! ("Please buy a ticket!")

items.english: Do you have a pass, or are you buying a ticket?

sections.content: Egy jegyet kérek reuses kérek and the accusative -t you already know from ordering food — buying a ticket is just another kérek + object sentence.
